identity: A chapter opening from a translated American political-history book (the early United States Senate, 1789-1803: its manners, its admission of press and ladies to the galleries, Aaron Burr, John Quincy Adams). Titled الزمان والمكان. Register = §N/§X translated scholarly nonfiction with long periodic sentences.
law: Translated expository history: cut at every fresh finite predication, weld everything subordinate. The productive cue here is و + كان / و + finite verb, which cuts (وكان مجلس الشيوخ, وكان أعضاؤه, وتولت, وتم, وأكد, وظلت, وقال, وهزم, وستطول) - the exact pattern I missed 18 times in doc_a74a9e93d97a. Full-form ولكن with an independent clause cuts. A fronted adverbial or concessive (ففي سنة, وفي سنة, وما إن, على الرغم من أن, وعلى الرغم من أن) attaches FORWARD, so the boundary goes before it, never after. Protected and welded: و + noun or preposition in a list (وقاعاته, والسفراء ورؤساء الدوائر والحكام, the وفي chain, the وأولئك chain), trailing وذلك / عندما / لأن / الذي, an apodosis فإن or إلا أن demanded by its protasis, and a speech verb with its quotation (انبرى قائلا وماذا عن السيدات, وقال ماديسون إنه).
reasoning: Paragraph 1 turns on four وكان sites (@24 @43 @51 @68) and I cut before all of them - @23 @42 @50 @67. The one I had to think about is @40 وقاعاته: no finite verb follows the و, it is an elliptical comparative continuing أكثر أبهة وشكليات, so it welds and the cut lands one clause later at @42 زركشة. @63 يتشاور is asyndetic but is a serial predicate in an obvious list of Senate behaviours (met / adopted no committees / consulted), so I welded it and took the cut at @67 instead. Three long segments are syntactically forced and I accepted them rather than manufacture cuts: @284-@353 (70 tokens) is a single concessive period وعلى الرغم من أن X وتضمنت Y فإن Z عندما... لأن..., where وتضمنت sits inside the protasis and every later joint is a trailing subordinate; @360-@405 (46 tokens) is a second such concessive whose predicate is كثيرا ما اضطر, with two coordinated لأنهم causals; @490-@538 (49 tokens) is one long subject list (الرجال الذين... وأولئك الذين... x3, one of them a duplicated scrape artifact) closed by the resumptive هؤلاء كانوا رجال مثل تلك الأوقات, which is the same sentence, not a new one. Paragraph 3 is where the register shows its true density - eight cuts in 112 tokens, at ففي, وفي, وما إن, وتم, ولكن, وأكد, ولكن - averaging 13 tokens, which is the band LAW 0-quad predicts. Overall 28 boundaries over 545 real tokens = 19.5, above my 18 guideline but entirely attributable to the three forced periods; the remaining segments average about 14.
